sloka: पूर्वम् आपतितः क्रोधात् स त्वाम् आह्वयते युधि ।निष्पत्य च निरस्तः ते हन्यमानो दिशो गतः ॥४-१५-१०॥
transliteration: pūrvam āpatitaḥ krodhāt sa tvām āhvayate yudhi ।niṣpatya ca nirastaḥ te hanyamāno diśo gataḥ ॥4-15-10॥

translations.english: 'Earlier, he (Sugriva) came and challenged you to a duel. You struck him in anger, and defeated, he fled, running in all directions. Now his challenge rouses my suspicion.
